story_sentence: Everyone thinks AI growth is about algorithms, but OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank are turning it into a $500B physical infrastructure buildout.

caption:
OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank have announced five new datacenter sites under Project Stargate, accelerating a $500B, 10-gigawatt U.S. infrastructure buildout.

AI is no longer just a software race. It has officially shifted into a heavy industry war for grid power, real estate, and transformers.

What are your thoughts on compute expanding at utility scale? Comment below.
